## Outline

- Monitoring change with UAS: applications, metrics, and survey design
- The GRASS temporal framework: space-time raster datasets, time stamps, listing and plotting a series
- Aggregation and per-cell statistics over time: count and intersection, monthly aggregates, core and envelope surfaces
- Identifying distorted surveys from the core surface
- Applications: crop height and biomass from map algebra on the series, viewsheds on the lidar and envelope DSMs, volumes of structures
